comment: Be ready to participate. He's pretty no-nonsense and it's important that you attend every class. Do not piss him off. Also, it's important to meet with him for essays (he can grade somewhat harshly). That being said, he gives very entertaining lectures and is a great teacher. I definitely left with improved critical thinking and writing skills.
He's good with lecturing, but you are graded on only a few papers and he grades harshly.

This is a great class to take if you need to fulfill your gen ed requirement. He keeps it lively and interesting and the homework is usually pretty short. The only assignments are three papers, so participation matters but he is always happy to meet with students after class and gives great feedback. The only book required is a short novel.
Very passionate professor and has high expectations for his students. He has very strict deadlines for the written assignments and encourages participation when discussing the readings in class.

Dr. Galgano is an amazing professor. He keeps a history class interesting (hard to do in my opinion) and is very fair. His class is based on 3 essays and participation, so make sure you are ready to talk. He encourages after class help and I always left learning something new. I would definitely recommend.

Class consisted of 3 papers and participation for grades. That's it. For class you read primary sources then talk about them the whole time. He's very knowledgeable and funny and genuinely interesting. The papers are 1 page, 3 pages, and 8 pages and you do have to try pretty hard on them. Overall good class to take for history requirement.

This was a very fun history course. Dr. Galgano is nice and taught history in a way I had never experienced before. We did 3 papers (1 page, then 3, then 8) throughout the semester and the rest of your grade comes from participating in discussion on the homework readings. The readings usually weren't too bad and can be skimmed. No midterm or final

Dr. Galgano was easily my favorite professor this semester. He is hilarious, approachable, and accessible outside of class. He gives a lot of feedback on papers and is happy to meet with you outside of class to discuss them. He really encourages you to think deeply about the topic. I wish I could take him again but he only teaches this course.
An inspirational and passionate instructor! He can always incite my interests to historical studies after reading lots of materials.

He is the man! I pretty sure that I'll never bump into such a charismatic and genuine professor like Dr. Galgano. He flips history on its tail and provides with the necessary materials to look through a scope that is not offered by many other professors. 3 big essays and participation grade are everything in this class, not to mention the lectures.

I have never in my life liked a history class before. Dr. Galgano's Gilded Ages class has been my favorite class so far at school. He's engaging, funny, motivating, and pushes his students to think outside the box and to view the world in a different light. HIGHLY recommend taking this class. I would do it again if I could.

Dr. Galgano has been my favorite professor at this school. He leads class discussion and always encourages participation from students in a positive manner. He keeps things extremely interesting and pushes everyone to think outside of the box. He's a great guy and cares about his students. I wouldn't hesitate to take another one of his classes.

Took him for Rebellions in Early America and it was an enjoyable course. Dr. Galgano is an amazing teacher, keeps the class engaged, and his lectures are very interesting. An all around cool guy. Participation is important. Only drawback is that he is an extremely tough grader on papers, but going to see him helps a lot.

Easy class for a gen ed. The readings can be long and boring at times, but class discussions are usually interesting. He gets really upset if you miss classes or don't participate though. Overall I would recommend this course for a gen ed because he makes history interesting.
One of the best prof at Richmond. He is very helpful and clear! definitely take him if you want a history credit!

Contrary to most other ratings, I did not have a great experience in this class.  Some of that goes to the subject itself of course(dense, uninteresting material) but some of it is because Galgano is a tough grader,is not very encouraging, and comes off as pretty arrogant.  Sure, he's funny sometimes but that ain't helpin my grade
Worst class I've ever taken. Stay far, far away from this guy! If history is your "thing", it won't be after a semester with him.

Awesome professor! not the most challenging course, but he does give new and useful writing tips through his 3 brief papers. Very charismatic and interesting guy and class isn't that hard. Highly recommended.

By far the best professor I have had at UR. I took his class for the gen Ed requirement and it ended up being my favorite class of the semester. There is reading or every class but only 3 essays for the entire semester, 2 of which are short. He is an amazing lecturer who manages to make somewhat dry material very interesting. I can't wait to take another class with him!

One of the best professors that I've had here. He is very engaging and definitely enjoys teaching. Homework isn't too bad (30ish pgs of reading every night), and if you participate in class and meet with him to discuss corrections on papers, you should get an A in the class.
Absolutely best and funniest teacher I've had at U of R. Doesn't demand a lot. Participation is necessary. TAKE HIM!

He is one of my favorite professors at UR. He makes class very interesting and fun. I never felt like I was bored, and I wasn't interested in history until this class. He also really wants you to do well. He understands that many people take this class to fill the GER, and so he offers re-writes on essays. He is great! Definitely take his class!

excellent professor. funny, very engaging, smart, always willing to help you out of class. participation is important to him and read the sylabus closely so you know what he accepts and doesnt accept.  absolutely loved him.
Dr. Galgano is the best professor I have had a Richmond. He is very engaging and never talks down to students, regardless of their aptitude. He is a hard grader, but definitely worth it!

He is a great teacher...I didn't even like history and was just taking his class to get the gen ed requirement out of the way.  After a month of his classes, I'm considering history as a minor.  He enjoys his teaching and engages his students in the lecture.  Awesome.
Great teacher, very tough grader, but extremely entertaining in the classroom.

Galgano is an incredible teacher, definitely worth taking whether you need your core requirement or your a history major. Regardless of your prior interest in the subject, he will definetly make it interesting. Pretty hard grader, but certainly fair.

Knows his stuff extremely well. All you do is listen to lectures and have a discussion on Fridays.  Be sure to participate. Very, very good and enthusiastic speaker. Grades tough on the few papers he assigns. I suggest taking him for United States up to 1877.

loved the guy- very engaging with his lectures, interesting, and a great speaker! besides the crease that is across his dress shirt EVERY CLASS, he's not too bad on the eyes either. tough paper grader, but i really liked the class. i learned a lot about succinctly phrasing a paper topic without three pages of pure bull! fab fab- take him!

prof. galgano is such a great guy, i hated missing his class because I loved listening to his lectures. you actually LEARN a lot about history in his class, and he makes it interesting! but, he gives lofty papers to write, and is brutal with the grading on them. he'll help you re-write, but it doesn't help much.

Ridiculous grader.  Grading comments that make no sense, and then when you correct all the problems he pointed out, you'll wind up with the same grade as you had on the rough draft.  Also quite politically biased.  Has a fairly selective memory of history.  He is interesting, if that's what your concern is.  I'll never take a class with him again.

Professor Galgano was one of the most remarkable teachers I ever had. All of his lectures were so engaging and I was always interested in the notes he gave to the class. Although his class was enjoyable, he was a hard grader on papers. I recommend him.

He is the best teacher I have ever had.  Every class is interesting.  He has a great sense of humor, and is an engaging speaker.  You feel like you can go to him for help as much as you want, and he helps you to improve more with each assignment.

Galgano's one of the best professors I've had in college! The lectures were so engaging, I was never bored with the material. Assignments were very specific - while the grading's tough, you are asked to resubmit the papers. Great guy!

Dr. Galgano is one of the best teachers I've had at Richmond.  He makes boring material interesting and it makes you enjoy his class.  He grades very hard on papers but lets you rewrite them and is very helpful outside of class and he really helped my writing improve.  Not an easy grader but a great teacher.

Extremely engaged in teaching.  The lectures are entertaining and interesting-even when talking about things like the New Deal and policy.  But I am a strong writer but he is an EXTREMELY difficult grader - to the point of ridiculousness.  He will help you write pepers but it doesnt help your grade.

really interesting lectures every day, very clear on what is expected.  you only have 3 papers to write (all with pg maximums) but he is very helpful and willing to help you.  critical on papers, but definitely a great teacher

He is a great teacher, but an extremely HARD grader. His lectures are interesting and funny and he is ALWAYS willing to help you with paper assignments (sometimes he even forces you to meet with him). If you have a struggle with writing, this class might be a challenge. Nice guy too.
